The structure of composition H₂N₂O₈ (reduced formula HNO₄) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 44 atoms in the unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies nitrogen centers as tetrahedral (four O neighbors), while oxygen centers show two- and three-neighbor environments and hydrogen centers are single-coordinate to O. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single two-dimensional component containing all 44 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts reveal corner-sharing between N tetrahedra and corner-sharing between N tetrahedra and O-centered three-vertex polyhedra.
